dedupe_keys.name: development of a validated methodology for seismic analysis and design of standard and pile supoorted retaining walls

description: Development of a validated methodology for seismic analysis and design of standard and pile-supoorted retaining walls is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Scott Brandenberg, University of California Los Angeles (ucla.edu). This project provides Jupyter notebooks for computing seismic earth pressures acting on lateral earth retention systems using a Winkler-based elastic solution. The solutions are for shear waves propagating vertically through continuously inhomogeneous elastic soil acting against flexible walls constrained by elastic rotational and translational springs at the top and bottom. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-2a8t-4v50. Keywords: Seismic earth pressure, Jupyter, Soil-structure interaction.. Published 2021-07-21. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
